summary.narrowest_defensible_thesis: On 0<=theta<=1/192 the periodic Meron row-sum covariance has a unique volume limit with eps_L<=4 M_1 L (128 theta)^L, uniformly summable kernels and nonnegative modes; nonzero modes are strictly positive only on 0<theta<=2537/100281465600.
summary.evidence_scope: Written cluster-expansion proofs importing the Kotecky-Preiss criterion; exact Fraction CAR series on L=4,6,8 rings and open chains with mutations; arithmetic-only Lean module compiled standalone (no axioms).
summary.next_concrete_test: An L-uniform bound sup_u|g_L(u)-1/2|<=c theta with c of order 1, plus a sharper lower bound on F, giving 2 theta F - theta^2|ghat(m)|>0 on theta_*<theta<=1/192.
